purpose: Detailed visual specifications and reusable prompts for generating projectile sprites. These entries describe art direction; they do not set gameplay balance values.

shared_asset_guidelines.style: Crisp 2D pixel art with a consistent dark outline, deliberate pixel clusters, limited palette, and a readable silhouette at native size.
shared_asset_guidelines.camera_and_view: Side-facing projectile sprite suitable for a 2D game; rotate in the game engine when the projectile travels at an angle.
shared_asset_guidelines.background: Fully transparent. No mockup, checkerboard, scene, ground, cast shadow, character, hand, weapon wielder, text, labels, watermark, or UI.
shared_asset_guidelines.lighting: Use clustered pixel highlights rather than smooth gradients or blur. Glow and trails should usually be separate effect sprites so they can be recolored and toggled.
shared_asset_guidelines.animation_sheets: When animation is requested, use consistent cell dimensions, aligned centers, equal spacing, transparent gutters, and no labels. Specify frame count explicitly.
shared_asset_guidelines.scaling: Use nearest-neighbor scaling to preserve pixel edges. Confirm final canvas size against Potaria's actual sprite scale before batch generation.
shared_asset_guidelines.readability: The projectile's silhouette and travel direction must remain identifiable at 1x scale. Avoid excessive micro-detail, excessive bloom, and colors too similar to the common background.
shared_asset_guidelines.cultural_direction: For Filipino-inspired entries, use original fantasy designs inspired by item forms or broad motifs. Do not copy a specific sacred, ceremonial, or community-specific symbol without appropriate research and approval.
pipeline: Generate one projectile at a time using its asset_generation_prompt.
Inspect transparency, silhouette, outline consistency, and native-size readability.
Normalize canvas, pivot, and orientation before importing.
Generate trails and impact effects as separate assets where possible.
Record approved assets and variants in the project's asset manifest.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: returning
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Returns toward its owner after a trigger or time.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: ricochet
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Bounces from eligible surfaces or targets.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: splitting
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Creates child projectiles at a trigger point.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: burst
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Creates a radial group of child projectiles.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: persistent
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Remains active for a duration or creates a lingering hazard.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: charged
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Changes appearance or gameplay parameters based on charge state.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: chain
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Jumps to additional targets after a valid hit.

behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.name: orbiting
behavior_types_not_separate_art_by_defau.description: Circles a player, target, or point.

effect_asset_families.name: Physical Hit
effect_asset_families.description: Small metal sparks, wood splinters, stone chips, and a brief hit flash.

effect_asset_families.name: Magic Hit
effect_asset_families.description: A compact color-matched ring, 3–5 motes, and a short flash.

effect_asset_families.name: Fire Impact

effect_asset_families.name: Ice Impact

effect_asset_families.name: Lightning Impact
effect_asset_families.description: Sharp electric flash with branching arcs.

effect_asset_families.name: Poison or Acid Impact
effect_asset_families.description: Colored splat, droplets, and optional short-lived vapor.

effect_asset_families.name: Explosion
effect_asset_families.description: Small, medium, and large radial bursts with smoke and fragments on separate layers.

effect_asset_families.name: Piercing Hit
effect_asset_families.description: Narrow directional flash with a compact puncture mark.

effect_asset_families.name: Shield Impact
effect_asset_families.description: Brief curved defensive flash with a few sparks; keep it separate from projectile art.

effect_asset_families.name: Boss Impact
effect_asset_families.description: Larger ring and high-contrast burst, with duration and intensity tuned in gameplay.

effect_asset_families.name: Projectile Trail
effect_asset_families.description: Reusable short streaks, ember particles, motes, smoke, or color-matched afterimages.

effect_asset_families.name: Projectile Destruction
effect_asset_families.description: A short disappearance animation for ordinary hits, expiry, or cancellation.

projectiles.trail_effect: Very short faint motion streak at high speed; no persistent glow.
projectiles.impact_effect: Small metallic spark and a tiny directional hit mark; wood or stone may add a small splinter.

prompt_template: Create a game-ready projectile sprite for Potaria using this specification: {visual_description}. Palette: {palette}. Material/surface: {material_and_surface}. Animation: {flight_animation}. Trail: {trail_effect}. Impact concept: {impact_effect}. Use crisp 2D pixel art, default 32x32 transparent PNG, strong readable silhouette, consistent dark outline, deliberate pixel clusters, limited palette, no smooth gradients, and nearest-neighbor-friendly edges. Show only the projectile asset centered on a transparent background. No character, hand, weapon wielder, scenery, ground, UI, text, label, watermark, or mockup. If animation is requested, use aligned equal-size frames and no labels. Treat gameplay behavior as separate from the art.
